mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction is not positively correlated with the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.2% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in months where UNRATE exceeds 4.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that precedes a slowdown in corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return direction is not positively correlated with the 1-month change in PAYEMS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate a severe economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline from prior period
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from their respective prior periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive policy that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.
